Linter coverage gap (NOT an execution bypass): no linter rule inspects payload files for script-ness, so a working script file in the payload lints PASS. Contained: the installer is copy-only (no subprocess/exec/import token in install.py), so a payload script is inert at install time.

negative_controls.description: The linter must PASS a benign package and the installer must install it, so a reject-everything linter cannot be mistaken for secure. Bad state = the self_test-tampered payload (FAIL); good state = the benign package (PASS + install).
MKT-L08 must fire on excessive permissions when a trust policy is supplied and be silent on the benign package.
The installer permission gate (MKT-I05) must REFUSE the over-permissioned package even forced into a signed index, and install the benign one.
MKT-L01 (additionalProperties:false) must fire on an undeclared manifest hook field and be silent on the benign manifest.

negative_controls.description: MKT-L01 must fire on a manifest carrying a shadow field and be silent on the benign manifest.
MKT-L01 (relative_path pattern) must fire on a payload path that traverses outside root and be silent on benign payload paths.
MKT-L02 (digest) and MKT-L06 (SBOM) must fire on payload byte drift vs the signed manifest and be silent on the intact benign payload.

report.answer: Independently re-derived 2026-08-16 (fresh fixture marketplace, one-abuse-per-variant, disposable install oracle). Of the 5 abuses the linter cleanly REJECTS 3: a shadow manifest field (MKT-L01), a payload path outside root (MKT-L01 relative_path + ensure_within), and declared-vs-actual drift (MKT-L02 + MKT-L06). Two are PARTIAL linter gaps that are NOT end-to-end bypasses: (1) excessive permissions lint PASS in the DEFAULT no-policy mkt lint path but FAIL with a policy and the installer REFUSES them (MKT-I05); (2) a working script FILE in the payload lints PASS but the installer is copy-only and never executes it. No abuse achieved an install-time escape or code execution. Benign control PASSES the linter and installs.
